text:
maria-scott: Heads-up — planning a dry-run for multi-region failover toggle tomorrow 09:30 PT. Want quick sign-off on scope: canary audience, stickiness, fallback model/region, and rollback play.
kevin-lin: +1. propose canary = 5% of EU traffic only, wave for 15m, monitor P95 latency and error-rate. Stickiness by session_id, TTL=30s. :thumbsup:
sophia-ng: That TTL seems fine for short sessions. For chat flows, maybe 45s? shorter TTL could re-route mid-conversation.
jonas-sre: Re: metrics — add KV cache hit % and token throughput to monitors. If P95 > 700ms OR error-rate > 1.5% we abort and rollback automatically.
lucy-prodeng: For fallback model, prefer `rwd-model-compact-v2` in us-west-2 (lower memory, quantized). Confirming acceptable quality delta? we should gate on regression <2% BLEU-ish metric from eval set.
maria-scott: Good call. Gate = latency+error OR quality regressions from smoke prompts. Rollback = feature flag off + immediate traffic cut to primary region.
kevin-lin: Ops checklist snippet:
```
/rollout start --flag multi_region_failover --canary 5 --regions eu --stickiness session_id --ttl 30
/monitor add p95_latency,err_rate,kv_cache_hit,token_throughput
```
I'll run the commands and stand by.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: rollout/multi_region_failover -> canary 5% EU. ETA 2m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall paging window active during dry-run. Pager escalation set to 5m.
sophia-ng: Quick Q: what about user-scoped orgs with strict residency? they should be excluded from canary. We should add `exclude_tags: ["gdpr:eu-only"]`.
kevin-lin: Good catch. Will add exclude_tags filter to rollout.
jonas-sre: I'll keep a terminal open to run emergency cut: `rollback multi_region_failover --now`. Also will warm the fallback model containers in us-west-2 before start.
lucy-prodeng: Can someone add the short checklist to the runbook? I'll update the docs after the dry-run. :memo:
maria-scott: Thanks all — if no objections I'll start the rollout at 09:30 PT. Ping here when warmed and ready. :eyes:
